meta.description: Run a complete protein binder design campaign with NVIDIA Proteina-Complexa: resolve a target structure and hotspots from a name/sequence/PDB, co-design binder sequence+structure with reward-guided test-time search (best-of-n, beam search, FK steering, MCTS), select with the internal AF2 reward gate, then INDEPENDENTLY validate each binder by refolding the complex with Boltz2 (default) or OpenFold3 and rank on interface confidence, pLDDT, ipSAE, apo/holo stability, and hotspot contact.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated identifiers or quantitative results; uses validated metrics (ipTM, ipSAE, pLDDT from literature); Dunbrack ipSAE script cited with MIT license; mechanism details accurate

practice_boundaries.detail: Not a medical diagnostic skill; includes dual-use screening for pathogen/toxin/bioweapon applications with explicit decline guidance

methodological_ground.detail: Appropriate use of independent validation (different model family); evidence-based hotspot selection with clear priority order; gate criteria scientifically sound; no ethical compliance issues for protein engineering research

code_usability.detail: 13 Python/Bash scripts present and structurally sound; syntax-checked key scripts (pipeline.py, validate_binders.py, boltz2_refold.py); dependencies documented (numpy, biotite, pyyaml); setup verification script provided

functional_suitability.note: Complete end-to-end pipeline covering target resolution (4 sources), hotspot selection (4 strategies), generation (4 algorithms), validation (holo+apo), gating (7 criteria), ranking, and GO/NO-GO reporting

reliability.note: Preflight checks, retry/backoff for rate limits, bounded-budget loop with multiple stop conditions, comprehensive failure tracking; could improve mid-campaign recovery guidance

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is 202 lines (dense but organized); uses 5 reference files for progressive disclosure; smart optimizations (validates only 2×N, bounded 2-round loop, lean generate path)

agent_usability.note: Clear 4-stage structure with ASCII diagram; excellent feedback (preflight, per-design pass/fail, GO/NO-GO); strong error prevention; high complexity due to 13 scripts and multiple tools

human_usability.note: Clear section headers and script list; 202-line main file requires scrolling; interplay between Complexa CLI and this skill could be clearer upfront

security.note: Environment variables for credentials with explicit never-hardcode reminder; structure alignment validates coordinates; dual-use screening for bioweapon applications

maintainability.note: Excellent modularity with stage-separated scripts and 5 reference files; gate thresholds configurable; algorithm and validator switchable; tests directory present; no CI/CD mentioned

agent_specific.note: Excellent trigger precision; uses progressive disclosure with references; strong composability (boltz2-nim, msa-search-nim, science-skills); seed control with manifest tracking; dual-use escape hatch present

recommendations.title: Reduce main SKILL.md token cost
recommendations.problem: Main SKILL.md is 202 lines, exceeding the ideal <150 line target for efficient context loading. Performance/Context scored 5/8.
recommendations.root_cause: Inline details like hotspot evidence order, Stage 2 command examples, and Stage 3 validation policy could move to reference files.
recommendations.fix: Move hotspot resolution details to target-and-hotspots.md, Stage 2 Complexa CLI examples to complexa-cli.md, and Stage 3 conditioning policy to validation.md. Keep only essential workflow structure and pointers in main SKILL.md.

recommendations.title: Add mid-campaign recovery guidance
recommendations.problem: No explicit restart-from-stage guidance if a failure occurs mid-campaign (e.g., validation crashes after generation completes). Reliability 2.3 scored 3/4.
recommendations.root_cause: pipeline.py mentions score_existing mode but recovery steps not documented in SKILL.md.
recommendations.fix: Add to references/pipeline.md: Recovery section explaining how to resume from manifest.json, which stages can restart independently, and when to use score_existing mode vs full re-run.

recommendations.title: Clarify user-modified gate criteria handling
recommendations.problem: Input 5: User requested stricter gate criteria (ipTM ≥ 0.75, pLDDT ≥ 0.80, RMSD ≤ 1.5) but output used default thresholds without clarification. One assertion failed.
recommendations.root_cause: No guidance in SKILL.md on whether/how to honor user-specified thresholds vs defaults.
recommendations.fix: Add to Stage 3 or references/validation.md: Gate Override section explaining that user-requested thresholds should trigger AskUserQuestion to confirm before applying, or document that only defaults are supported with clear communication when user requests differ.
